column1: # Wrestlers whose SDH profile lives at a combined ring-name slug the fetcher
# can't guess from the roster slug. Resolved from SDH's sitemap by name-token
# match (2026-07-08), then filtered to high-confidence, unambiguous mappings.
# Ambiguous ones (butch/pete-dunne, ezekiel, stardust, ted-dibiase, mikey,
# jevon-evans) were intentionally left out to avoid putting wrong data on a
# profile. Used by fetch-overrides.sh and build-profiles.js (for source_url).
